name: Conversion.ai
summary: Former copywriting brand. The domain now presents a different product.
description: Conversion.ai was an earlier name of the Jasper copywriter. On 21 October 2026, conversion.ai answered with the title “Conversion | AI-Native B2B Marketing Automation Platform” and described an agentic marketing product, not the old copy tool. Jasper is the successor of the copywriting product. This card is not a free writing tool.
